source_summary: The symbol ◌ represents any Khmer consonant or consonant plus foot; → means is romanized.
conditions_or_exceptions: Placeholder notation only; not a phonological rule.
limitations: Does not define syllable parsing or resolve ambiguous foot identity.

source_summary: MUUSIKATOAN ◌៊ changes an â-series consonant to ô-series; TRIISAP ◌៉ changes an ô-series consonant to â-series.
conditions_or_exceptions: MUUSIKATOAN does not shift ប/បា; Note 3 specifies that ប with TRIISAP remains p in the â-series. Marks are frequently omitted, especially in words of Indic provenance.
example_scope: Guide examples héang, nhâng and the Note 3 BA exception.
limitations: Only one correctly positioned shifter after one base or one supported base+foot cluster; BA+TRIISAP is handled as a Note 3 exception, while BA+foot with a shifter remains unsupported. Omitted marks cannot be reconstructed; the resolver returns series metadata only.

source_summary: A foot normally determines the following nucleus series; the base determines it when the foot is weak: nasals ង ញ ណ ន ម and យ រ ល វ. ប/បា with TRIISAP and ប/បា with a foot are romanized p in the â-series.
conditions_or_exceptions: The resolver supports one modeled foot and preserves the exact PCGN weak set; the BA+TRIISAP and BA+foot exceptions select p in the â-series. Subscript identity may require reference consultation.
example_scope: Guide examples thmâ, pâng, plêng, p’â, prăb and Note 3 BA exceptions.
source_locator: Consonant table notes after table; Notes §3
limitations: Series metadata only: one base and at most one modeled foot; do not extend the weak list with ស (UNGEGN 2013 delta), and do not infer an ambiguous foot's underlying consonant. No vowel or complete romanization output.

source_summary: The â-series consonant អ is represented by an apostrophe.
conditions_or_exceptions: Resolver requires explicit word-initial and following-vowel-letter context; the apostrophe is optional only when both are true.
limitations: Only the onset apostrophe component is returned; following-vowel and word-boundary context must be caller-supplied, not inferred; no IPA/Ukrainian output is produced.

source_summary: BANTOC ◌់ occurs in ◌◌់ and ◌ា◌់; SAMYOK SANNYA ◌័ occurs in ◌័◌. BANTOC-only inherent pattern is á/ó; AA+BANTOC and SAMYOK patterns are ă in the â-series, eă before k/ng/h in the ô-series, and oă otherwise.
conditions_or_exceptions: Resolver accepts only the three exact Note 5 token shapes, an onset-only analysis, and an explicit caller-supplied coda class; it does not infer syllable boundaries or codas.
example_scope: Guide examples bát, chăk, rôpeăk, moăt, veăngk, phoăpv.
limitations: No context-free output; onset series and coda class must be explicit, and only the vowel component is returned.

source_summary: ROBAT ◌៌ is romanized rC, where C is any romanized Khmer consonant; the bounded resolver returns r plus an explicitly supplied PCGN consonant value.
conditions_or_exceptions: The mark must follow one modeled unstacked consonant at the end of the supplied component chunk; the caller supplies the marked consonant romanization from its contextual PCGN table decision.
limitations: The consonant value is caller-supplied, not inferred; no syllable boundary is inferred; the resolver returns only the rC component and does not produce IPA/Ukrainian output.

source_summary: ◌៏ is not romanized in syllable-initial position; in syllable-final position it indicates that the consonant is vowelled with â or ô according to series.
conditions_or_exceptions: Resolver requires explicit caller-supplied syllable position; final position additionally requires an explicit â/ô series value.
example_scope: Guide examples sâ, sâsâs, tâmnâ, pômô.
limitations: Syllable position and final series are never inferred; the resolver returns only the AHSDA mark effect, not a complete syllable.

source_summary: ◌៍ appears above characters that are not pronounced and is not romanized; the bounded resolver returns only an explicit marked-character omission decision.
conditions_or_exceptions: Caller must identify the exact marked consonant grapheme; the resolver verifies it immediately precedes the final TOANDAKHIAT mark.
limitations: Marked character is caller-identified, not inferred; only unstacked/subscript consonants are supported; no remaining word romanization or IPA/Ukrainian output.

source_summary: Independent vowel ឧ is romanized ŏ or ŭ.
conditions_or_exceptions: The resolver preserves both alternatives as explicit options and requires a reference source before selecting either.
example_scope: Independent/Dependent Vowel Characters table row 7; Notes §9.
source_locator: Independent/Dependent Vowel Characters table row 7; Notes §9
limitations: No alternative is selected without lexical/reference evidence; no IPA or Ukrainian output is produced.

source_summary: The guide enumerates the Unicode code points for the romanization system's modified Latin letters, including precomposed and decomposed breve forms.
conditions_or_exceptions: A bounded validator accepts basic ASCII Roman letters and the exact Note 10 modified-letter inventory; œ+COMBINING BREVE and Œ+COMBINING BREVE remain two-code-point sequences.
limitations: Inventory validation only: non-letter characters are passed through, not validated; no normalization, transliteration, IPA or Ukrainian output is performed.

source_summary: The tables show lowercase forms; uppercase and lowercase Roman letters should be used as appropriate when romanizing.
conditions_or_exceptions: Case follows the romanized text's orthographic context.
limitations: Does not define title casing or Ukrainian capitalization policy.
